trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no separate task: work through the roadmap stages in order, finish the 100% checklist for A Long Road last, and this is the reward. Expect around 200 hours in total, all offline, in a single playthrough.
steps: Earn all 54 other trophies, in any order.
The platinum unlocks immediately when the last one pops — no extra action needed.
Keep cheats off the whole run: cheats disable trophies and saving.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold for the in-game 100% Completion checklist — the hardest trophy and the real gate to the platinum. The checklist unlocks only after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. It is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests and collectibles are only partly required. You need any 100 Optional Missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 Challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 300 of 397 stunts, and full completion of robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing toward 100% is missable.
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist in order: robberies first (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans, 8 bank vaults), then collectibles and activities.
Complete any 100 Optional Missions — there are 200–300+, so expired ones do not matter.
Scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles with the WAiNK app and study 100 of 255 animals with binoculars.
Complete 70 of 80 Challenges — skip the 10 hardest.
Finish 15 of 18 card sets, 300 of 397 stunts, all 42 shooting-range gold medals and all 42 drone time trials.

Mix categories freely — under-the-bridges flights are the quickest. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this trophy. Track progress on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, or Progress > Activities > Stunts.
steps: Find stunt spots on the map: Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Do any 250 stunts across the four kinds — jumps, under bridges, knife flights, base jumps.
Under-the-bridges flights are the fastest way to rack up numbers.
Keep going to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_reason: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only one. There is a Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house that can only be done in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations in Leonida. Each spot counts +2 if you meditate there with both Jason and Lucia. Track progress at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and find spots on the map under Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida. A meditation only counts once the final zen animation has played. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed — but this trophy needs all 18, and the final spot requires playing as both characters together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break).
steps: IN CHAPTER 1: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept — the one possibly missable meditation.
Find the 18 spots: map > Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida; track at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
Meditate at each spot with both Jason and Lucia (+2 per spot) where possible.
Wait for the final zen animation at each spot — it only counts then.
The last spot needs both characters together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can free-roam with both characters: call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Cause carnage until you hit 4 stars, then escape on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic; if a helicopter chases you, shoot it down. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 vault-robbery missions, which always trigger 4 stars.
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Build a 4-star wanted level together.
Escape the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the easiest route.
The trophy pops once you are out of the heat zone, not just the search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can bring your partner (hold Right + Triangle to call them). Hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while staying chased the whole time — keep the flashing red/blue wanted level, not the red heat level. Wear an armored vest, carry sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not unlock, hit a fourth shop and keep going. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well, after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — loot a few items in each and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Rob 3 shops in a row (green icons) while staying wanted the whole time.
Loot items in each store and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.
If it does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth — the unlock is delayed.

The fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold Up, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning alone counts, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Track discovered vehicles at Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. You need 200 base-model scans for the 100% checklist, so this pops naturally on the way.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1 — scanning counts, driving is not needed.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle), and wear body armor from Ammu-Nation. Line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations work best — and drop them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting-range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; at Focus level 4 this gets much easier and may happen naturally.
steps: Raise Focus toward level 4 (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots).
Buff focus with food/drinks or Adrenaline before the attempt.
Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) at a gang operation with 5+ enemies grouped.
Drop 5 enemies in that one activation with an assault rifle.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and fly away. It must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge — planes parked on the airfield do not count. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).
steps: Go to VCIA and drive through a fence to the terminal E3/E4 plane.
Enter via the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit.
Reverse the plane to the airstrip and take off.
Fly at least 1 km away from the airport until it pops.

Get in a Rhino tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry-store robberies (marked with green icons in unfogged areas). Break in through the back door using the Snap Gun (do not kick the door — that triggers the alarm). Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
steps: Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun.
Pick a jewelry store (green icon) and enter via the back door with the Snap Gun.
Find the safe code note in the back room and loot the safe.
Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): it introduces vault robberies — tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag (hold Right to hand one off). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans (purple icons) and follow them to banks. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to go unrecognized. There are 8 large bank jobs total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way; a single vault can pay up to $205,000.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to unlock vault robberies.
Buy security-van tips from Yasmani ($10,000 each) and follow the vans to banks.
Rob the vault with your partner carrying a bag, then escape the 4-star heat.
Rob any 5 vaults — all 8 are needed for 100% anyway.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is the same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults (That's Where The Money Is…): robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank. Or do it earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. All 8 large bank jobs are needed for 100%, so this usually pops automatically.
steps: Either do the Chapter 4 vault mission — the bank-vault robbery counts — or find an armored truck near a bank in Vice City.
Block the truck, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open.
Loot it, then escape the red heat radius (or hit a Pay 'n' Spray).

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first (you need them for the safe). Inside, grab the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs). steps: Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, then go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Take the luxury watch (south-east office) and the Gutterball shotgun (north-east corner).
Blow the safe in the north-east hallway with sticky bombs and loot it.
Escape the police — the trophy pops then. Missed items can be collected on a later visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check Strength at Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength (heart icon). Raise it by working out — buy a fitness-club membership, and always go together with both characters (hold Right + Triangle to call your partner): while one works out, the other trains automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Fitness clubs are filterable on the map under Activities (dumbbell icon), and you can also work out at home after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), bring both characters to a fitness club together.
Buy a membership and work out — your partner trains automatically alongside you.
Raise Strength to maximum for both Jason and Lucia.
Check each character's Strength at Touchpad > Jason & Lucia.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. The profile runs from Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho, and Irredeemable is permanent if you keep using excessive violence — avoid that one, since cops then shoot on sight more often. Nearly every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this usually happens passively while doing the other trophies. If it is still short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications).
Play normally — robberies, fights and clean escapes all count toward the 500.
Watch for the demon-face notification to confirm actions are counting.
Avoid reaching Irredeemable (permanent); farm the last actions by running over enemies with a car if needed.

Look for the blinking car at the roadside; if absent, drive away and return.

trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). Rob banks and payday loans to get Marked Bills.
Bring the bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays best.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages. There are 12 garages in total, but 4 are story-related — only the 8 purchasable ones count, costing $160,000 altogether. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone, and you buy garages through that app. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

Open the app and buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total).
The 4 story garages do not count toward this trophy.
Fund it with robberies — Chapter 3–4 jobs pay the most.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes): each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage click Respray and Register. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
steps: Finish Chapter 2's Moses mission to get the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first — each one adds parking spots for registered vehicles.
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, click Respray then Register.
Register 10 vehicles; cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the cost down.
